findings.claim: v2's crash taxonomy is false for 2 of 3 windows: a crashed hop cannot re-run and a post-publish retry does not observe its PUBLISHED head -- it raises.
findings.author_verification: CONFIRMED by direct read: _reload_stream (trust.py:1720-1741) rehydrates ONLY self._streams; _stream_pin (1069) and _nonces (1057) are fresh per broker and never reconstructed; member bytes are never persisted. A retry reaches _prepare_receipt, which computes expected = _EVENTS[len(rows)] and raises 'replay of %s is refused' (2246-2248). seal/publish additionally require a live _Prepared whose _stream_pin entry is gone (1878-1884).
findings.consequence: the intent's only stream is permanently bricked -- an undisclosed failure mode standing in for the one v1 fixed
findings.disposition: CLOSED in v3 Decision point 1: attempt-indexed intent + read-only derivation_head accessor + an orchestrator contract that makes idempotence real; abandoned attempts are disclosed as permanently unresumable

findings.claim: DP6 analogized the new writer's invocation to compose_replay_tape -- the exact function whose defining defect is free-form caller-supplied metadata -- and nothing pinned the new signature against repeating it. produce performs no content verification (trust.py:1141-1174).
findings.author_verification: Accepted; the analogy was in v2's text and produce's non-verification is confirmed.
findings.disposition: CLOSED in v3 DP6: analogy withdrawn, signature hard-constrained to verified raw-event/v2 member bytes + verified roster policy, no free-form metadata parameter, RED asserts it

findings.claim: v2 did not name which resolver hop 3 uses, and its supporting text pointed at the dynamic path, which hardcodes {raw_event_dataset, source_roster} -- hop 1's pair, not hop 3's.
findings.author_verification: CONFIRMED by direct read: trust.py:9612-9619 hardcodes that pair and len(captures)==2; _FixedCapturedAuthorizationContract._prepare (5028-5111) is generic over cas['entries'] and handles replay subject kind at 5039; commit_p4_batch dispatches on resolver type at 5485-5489.
findings.disposition: CLOSED in v3 DP5: hop 1 -> dynamic resolver, hop 3 -> fixed resolver, both named with citations

findings.claim: v2 left bundles.py:653 _RAW_EVENT_V1_SCHEMA as a style precedent, leaving two independent declarations of the literal with only the trust-side one covered by the pinning test.
findings.author_verification: Accepted; v2's text did say 'the pattern to follow' rather than rewiring it.
findings.disposition: CLOSED in v3 DP4: bundles.py IMPORTS the trust-side table (production -> pipeline, the existing direction); the pinning test covers all nine sites

findings.claim: _development_broker is private, absent from __all__, and documented 'for focused tests only'; v2 named it as the production-side durability seam without resolving whether the claim is fixture-scoped or real.
findings.author_verification: CONFIRMED: trust.py:2301-2338, docstring at 2309, and _development_broker is absent from trust.__all__ (30-58).
findings.disposition: CLOSED in v3 DP1: the durability claim is stated explicitly as development-broker scope only; no export, no repurposing, and operational durability is named an open gate
